question: Does the 2018 Tokyo metropolitan person-trip survey distinguish upper-secondary students beyond age bands?

survey.name: Sixth Tokyo Metropolitan Area Person Trip Survey
survey.covered_residents: Tokyo excluding islands, Saitama, Chiba, Kanagawa, and southern Ibaraki
survey.sampling: Official handbook says results are expanded using regional sex-age resident population and other controls; this audit did not retrieve a target-cell weight or estimate

geography.Tokyo_23_wards_resident_zone_possible: Potentially aggregatable from resident zones in the custom system; no tabulation was run

availability.custom_aggregation_system: Available after user registration; not accessed
availability.decision: No matching target tabulation or weights obtained; no admission. Reviewed aggregate age/student-purpose categories alone do not isolate upper-secondary students; other restricted-record fields are not exhaustively assessed.

evidence_basis: Official-source text extraction for route notes; raw handbook/category/survey-scope retrievals failed TLS and were not independently re-extracted from local originals
